description: Machine-readable mirror of @momentarise/md-theme's design system. Generated from packages/md-theme/src/tokens.css by scripts/generate-design-tokens.mjs — do not edit by hand.

rules.accentScarcity: Accent color appears only on the primary action, the active mode, links, selection, focus, and checked todos. Never as decorative chrome.
rules.customization: Hosts override tokens, never selectors. A rebrand is a swap of the 12-step neutral and accent ramps.
rules.schemeOverride: Pin a scheme with <html data-mme-scheme="light|dark">; otherwise prefers-color-scheme decides.
